choice.basis: The dashboard 'Year vs. Number of doctors per 1,000 inhabitants' shows a consistent downward trend from approximately 1.3 in 2000 to approximately 2.4 in 2017. Because the y-axis is inverted (0.0 at the top, 2.5 at the bottom), the line moving downwards indicates an increase in the number of doctors per 1,000 inhabitants over time. The end-of-period pattern reflects a capacity expansion.
choice.option_label: Route to the physician capacity expansion review pathway
